page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred; a woodcut engraving in the middle with a banner; imprint below. No margin notes. The black stamps beside the engraving are not printed text.

main_text.l: S I X T I N I A M A M A F R I S I
Literarum Ebraicarum in Acad. Franekerana
Professoris,
ANTI-BARBARVS
B I B L I C V S.
Libro quarto auctus.
Quorum primus ostendit VII. fontes omnis Barbariei quae
superioribus seculis sacras literas fœdavit: reliqui non
solum exhibent centurias aliquot crassissimorum errorum
qui circa particularium locorum interpretationem ex istis
fontibus emanarunt, sed & complures locis Scripturæ
facem allucent.
Accesserunt variæ dissertationes & orationes, nec non responsio
ad censuras D. Martini Marsenni, Theologi Parisiensis.
Accessit & huic editioni ejusdem Commentariolus de De-
cimis Mosaicis.
FRANEQUERÆ,
Typis ISDARDI ALBERTI.
Sumptibus LUDOVICI & DANIELIS
ELZEVIRIORUM. Anno 1656.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a tree with a banner reading "VEEXTRAOLEA" (as far as legible) and a standing figure; no printed text beyond the banner. Black ink stamps ("Conventus S. Mariæ de Scala Romana") and a Google digitiser watermark are excluded. The year "1656" is followed by a flourished numeral mark. The banner text is partly illegible.
